title: Checked dynamic array traversal input
summary: Executes the standard UInt64 traversal guard and indexed element load from annotation-selected locals, preserving an arbitrary continuation.
premises: Frame getters for the input pointer and encoded traversal index
An in-bounds logical index and a valid item destination local
For the guarded form, an encoded effective stop greater than the current index
result: The exact emitted guard and indexed loader reach an arbitrary continuation with the selected array element in the item local.
